name: Pool and hot tub builder

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Pool consult
services.story: The main story: a free pool consult at the design center, or a seat in the free pool school class. Nothing is taken and nothing is owed.

services.name: 3D design package
services.story: The 3D design package, $500, paid in full when booking and credited to the build if the contract is signed within 60 days.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Pool build
services.story: The main story: a free site visit; a $68,000 pool in a signed contract; a $1,000 deposit after the cancel window; a bill for each stage when it is done and inspected, the last $7,000 after the final inspection.

services.name: Pool build
services.story: The same pool paid by the owners' lender: the stage draws go the business's own way, and Rosie sends no bills.

services.name: Hot tub install
services.story: A hot tub install priced from photos at $2,800; the written estimate signed, a 25% deposit of $700, the rest billed after start-up.

questions_before_times: what you want: a new in-ground pool, a renovation, or a hot tub install
the town or ZIP, and whether you own the home (only an owner can contract a build)
roughly the yard: size, slope, and whether a machine can get in (gate width, fences, trees)
for a hot tub: photos of the spot, the panel and the path from the street
safety_stop: a child or anyone in the water and not breathing, a drowning, an electric shock near water
a gas smell, a downed or sparking power line in the yard
license: a contractor's license for pool and spa construction where the state's rules require one (a pool or spa specialty license, or a general building license); registration only where the state licenses none; electrical and plumbing hookups by people licensed for them where the rules require it; a local building permit for every in-ground pool, and for hot tub wiring
